## Answers

**h01** — S3 presign runner — every 12 hours — `server/server.go:162-169`
The component is `s3presign.Runner` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:16`). It re-presigns S3-stored attachment URLs before they expire (schedule constant `runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12`, runner.go:27; each pass skips URLs still valid for 4+ days, runner.go:88). Wired into startup in `Server.startBackgroundRunners`: constructed at `server/server.go:162`, run once synchronously at `:163`, then looped in a goroutine via `s3presignRunner.Run(...)` at `:169`.

**h02** — delivery function: `webhook.Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120` (the actual `safeClient.Do(req)` outbound call is at `:152`); protection: SSRF guard via `safeDialContext` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:59`) which resolves the host and rejects reserved/private IPs through `isReservedIP` (`internal/webhook/validate.go:44`, CIDR list at `:14-23`). URLs are also validated up front by `webhook.ValidateURL` (`internal/webhook/validate.go:62`). The guard can be disabled by the `AllowPrivateIPs` flag (`validate.go:41`, set from `--allow-private-webhooks` at `cmd/memos/main.go:49`).

**h03** — abstraction package: `internal/idp` (`internal/idp/idp.go:1`, defines the shared `IdentityProviderUserInfo` contract); implementation package: `internal/idp/oauth2` (`internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go`, the OAuth2/OIDC provider — the only concrete protocol shipped).

**h04** — No. `mysql.NewDB` (`store/db/mysql/mysql.go:20`) is constructed only inside the driver-selection factory `db.NewDBDriver` at `store/db/db.go:22`. A whole-codebase search for callers of `NewDB` finds no other `mysql.NewDB` call — every non-factory call site uses `sqlite.NewDB` (tests: `store/demo_seed_test.go:24`, `store/deployment_config_test.go:416`) or goes through the factory (`cmd/memos/main.go:57`, `store/test/store.go:28,50`).

**h05** — Mechanism: explicit Go code (not a DB cascade). Evidence: the `reaction` table has no foreign key / `ON DELETE` rule in any dialect (`store/migration/{sqlite,mysql,postgres}/LATEST.sql` — the only cascade at line 108 is `memo_relation.memo_id`, not reaction). Deletion is done explicitly inside the user-delete transaction: by content-id at `store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:383` (and mysql:420 / postgres:383), and by creator-id in `deleteReactionsByCreatorTx` at `store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:400-402` (mysql:437-439 / postgres:400-402).

**h06** — Handlers (all reach the outbound request transitively): `APIV1Service.CreateMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70`), `APIV1Service.DeleteMemo` (`memo_service.go:518`), `APIV1Service.CreateMemoComment` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:20`), and the update path `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_update_helpers.go:66`). They converge in `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:48`) → `webhook.PostAsync` → the single delivery function **`webhook.Post`** (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`).

**h07** —
- `serveUserAvatar` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168` (Echo route `GET /file/users/:identifier/avatar`, registered at `fileserver.go:124`)
- `FileServerService.getUserByUsername` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715`
- `store.(*Store).GetUser` (called with `&store.FindUser{Username:...}`) — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:716` → `store/user.go`
- driver `GetUser` (default sqlite) — `store/db/sqlite/user.go`; the image bytes come from the fetched `user.AvatarURL` (data URI parsed at `fileserver.go:196`)

**h08** — Two declarers of `RunOnce`:
- `s3presign.Runner.RunOnce` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43`) — **invoked** — caller: `Server.startBackgroundRunners` (`server/server.go:163`), and internally by `Runner.Run` (`runner.go:36`).
- `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27`) — **not invoked** from production code — certified zero callers (used only via CLI/tests).

**h09** — Count: **7** distinct `Close` method declarations — `store/cache/cache.go` (2), `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:1`, `store/db/mysql/mysql.go`, `store/db/postgres/postgres.go`, `store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go`, `store/driver.go` (the `Driver` interface), `store/store.go` (`Store.Close`). Invoked by non-test server code: `store.(*Store).Close` (`store/store.go`) — called by `Server.Stop` at `server/server.go:146`; that in turn calls the selected driver's `Close` (interface `store/driver.go`, concrete `store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go` on a default install).

**h10** — `util.ConvertStringToInt32` — `internal/util/util.go:14` — approx fan-in ~5–6 (callers: `server/auth/authenticator.go:47` & `:67`, `server/router/api/v1/resource_name.go:73`, `:109`, `:122`). (The larger hubs in the codebase — `store.User`, `postgres.placeholder` — are declared under `store/`, not `internal/`.)

Of the three drivers implementing `store.Driver` (sqlite/mysql/postgres each declare `CreateMemo`), the sqlite one is the one wired at runtime for the default profile; `store.(*Store).CreateMemo` dispatches through the `Driver` interface to it.
